objective: Run the exact frozen Mini-ORIGIN v0.75 solver architecture on the seven cross-source OpenML-CC18 datasets hash-locked by v0.77, with independent Rust replay.

adapter_protocol.data: raw ARFF byte length, MD5 and SHA-256 must match the v0.77 lock before parsing
adapter_protocol.parser: liac-arff 2.5.0, dense ARFF only, UTF-8-sig strict decoding
adapter_protocol.target_column: the single exact committed OpenML target attribute
adapter_protocol.ignored_columns: only committed row_id_attribute and ignore_attribute names when present
adapter_protocol.feature_columns: all ARFF attributes in declared order except target and committed ignored columns
adapter_protocol.values: missing features become the empty token; other values are stripped string forms; labels must be nonempty
adapter_protocol.shape: record count equals frozen num_instances and declared attribute count equals frozen num_features

claim_boundary: A pass is a second, cross-source, repository-audited blind replication for the frozen Mini-ORIGIN method. It is not outside-human reproduction, direct state-of-the-art superiority, peer review, publication acceptance, a general AI breakthrough, or a world-first claim.
